title: Get the ultimate security for your MacBook by changing these privacy settings

claims.claim: MacBook ayarlarinda kilit ekrani sifresi olusturmak icin System Settings > Lock Screen yolu izlenir.

evidence.quote: To tweak these settings, go to System Settings > Lock Screen.

claims.claim: Konum Servisleri ayarlarına erismek icin Settings altindaki Privacy & Security bolumune gidilir.

evidence.quote: If you go to Settings, then Privacy & Security, you'll find Location Services.

claims.claim: MacBook uzerindeki Firewall secenegi varsayilan olarak kapali gelmektedir.

evidence.quote: your MacBook comes with a Firewall option that's off by default.

claims.claim: Firewall ozelligini acmak icin System Settings > Network > Firewall adimlari takip edilir.

evidence.quote: To turn it on, you can go to System Settings > Network > Firewall.

claims.claim: Apple Advertising bolumunden kisiselleştirilmis reklamlar kapatilabilmektedir.

evidence.quote: You can also just toggle off Personalized Ads.

claims.claim: Apple, anonim analitik verilerinin bir ay sonra silindigini belirtmektedir.

evidence.quote: Your analytics data then gets deleted after a month.

claims.claim: Analitik verilerini paylasmamak icin Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics Improvements yolu izlenir.

evidence.quote: If you'd just rather not take the risk, you can go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics Improvements and toggle off several choices like Improve Siri & Dictation and Share with App Developers.
